freeze.selection_scope: training-region spatial stripes only; no geographic scores read during training

interpretation: Each score hides a complete acquisition from the bidirectional Transformer; all other selected dates remain visible.
All methods are scored on exactly the same finite target pixels/channels with valid observations on both sides.
Interpolation uses the nearest valid neighbor on each side and actual acquisition times; temporal mean excludes the target.
Pixels and overlapping temporal windows are correlated; row/sample counts are not independent geographic replication.
Case IDs are a convenience check; spatial provenance must establish an independent geographic holdout.
This benchmark neither forecasts nor retrains/selects the model on held-out regions.

limitations: Complete-trajectory benchmark; valid but incomplete trajectories are excluded, which can bias toward easier support.
Only two fresh geographic tests; pixels and overlapping dates are correlated, not independent world cases.
Version comparison changes training data and architecture together; it is not an architecture ablation.
GP empirical coverage describes conditional historical observation intervals on these pixels; it is not globally calibrated process/sensor uncertainty.
No forecast, event class, causal attribution or hazard probability.
